name: v1.11-11200
body:
ChatEmote converts emoticons typed in any chat channel to Emotes.
Synonym emoticons can be linked, for example :) and :-) both to /smile.  
- Commands: **/chatemote** or **/cemo**
  - **/cemo list**  
    lists all emotes (in batches of 10s)
  - **/cemo link emoticon EMOTE**  
    links emoticon with EMOTE  
    example: /cemo link o_O CONFUSED
  - **/cemo unlink EMOTE**  
    removes any emoticons linked to EMOTE  
    example: /cemo unlink CONFUSED
  - **/cemo toggle**  
    disables or enables the addon for this session

After linking a few emoticons to EMOTES (by default the addon has a :) => /smile and :( => /cry link)
Just open any chat and type an emoticon, your character will perform the linked emote.

_v1.11-11200 bugfix /chatemote list_
